subject: EverBlue: ISO+SOC2 control map & evidence delivery plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@everblue.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evergreen RFP: ISO / SOC2 mapping + evidence logistics

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed in the RFP, procurement needs a clear control map that ties Redwood's controls to our ISO 27001 scope and SOC 2 CCs. Two asks to move us forward: 

1) A control mapping (ISO clauses -> SOC2 criteria -> Redwood control IDs) so our audit team can reconcile differences.
2) An initial inventory of available evidence for each control (audit logs, design docs, configuration screenshots, signed vendor attestations).

Can you confirm what you can deliver by Dec 2 and what will require additional work or third-party attestations? Our target is to complete reviews by Dec 15 to hit the year-end procurement window.

I've attached the RFP security questionnaire for reference. Also, we'll need a signed NDA (we can share ours if required).

Regards,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security Programs, EverBlue Finance
liam.oconnor@everblue.com
Attachment: everblue-rfp-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@everblue.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evergreen RFP: ISO / SOC2 mapping + evidence logistics

Hi Liam —

Great to hear from you. We can absolutely produce a mapping and an evidence index. Proposed approach and timelines: 

- Deliverable 1 (by Tue, Dec 2): a first-pass control map (ISO27001 clauses -> SOC2 CC -> Redwood control IDs) and a short summary of evidence available for each control.
- Deliverable 2 (by Fri, Dec 12): packaged artifacts (redacted logs, diagrams, sample reports, certificates) for review.
- Delivery method: shared Drive folder with a CSV manifest and hashed filenames; we'll also provide an artifact index PDF for quick review.

Questions for scoping: 
- Do you require evidence for customer-managed encryption keys (KMS) where the customer uses their own key? If so, we will need to coordinate the key custodian or provide design/controls for customer-managed scenarios.
- Scope: production-only systems vs. include staging/preprod? (staging may have reduced retention).

I'll CC Neha (security & compliance) and Jonas (product infra) to pick up the work. We'll attach an artifact index in the next email. Also, we've attached our template index to this thread.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: rbwd-soc2-iso-artifact-index.pdf (pdf)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@everblue.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Evergreen RFP: ISO / SOC2 mapping + evidence logistics

Liam / Alex —

Following up with the initial control mapping. Attached is a working workbook (everblue-ctrl-map-v1.xlsx) with three tabs: 
- Overview (ISO clause -> SOC2 CC mapping)
- Redwood controls (control IDs, owner, control type)
- Evidence matrix (available artifact types and example file names)

Key notes from our side: 
- We can supply logs (audit/tracing), IAM configuration exports, infrastructure design diagrams, and deployment runbooks for the production environment.
- Retention windows: auth and API logs retained for 18 months, system metrics and agent logs retained for 6 months (we can produce ad-hoc exports for older ranges with a 72-hour turnaround).
- KMS/HSM: Redwood uses a managed KMS for host keys and supports customer-managed keys in Dedicated/Private deployments. We do not hold third-party vendor HSM attestations for customer-managed keys. If EverBlue requires HSM vendor attestation, we'll need to coordinate with the customer's KMS vendor or provide alternate compensating evidence (design docs + key rotation logs).

Open items we need from EverBlue to finalize artifacts: 
- Confirm scope (production only vs. include staging).
- If you require customer-managed KMS evidence, please advise whether we should coordinate with your procurement/KMS team or submit compensating controls.
- Any specific control IDs you want prioritized for initial delivery.

I'll be available for a technical walkthrough this week — happy to demo how we extract logs and the evidence format.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Attachment: everblue-ctrl-map-v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Date: Tue, 02 Dec 2025 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Delivery: EverBlue control map + delivery manifest (links + next steps)

Hi Liam / Marta —

Per the timeline we committed, we've uploaded the initial deliverables to the shared Drive folder and attached a delivery manifest. Quick summary below: 

Deliverables included (Drive folder & manifest):
- everblue-ctrl-map-v1.xlsx (control mapping workbook)
- rbwd-soc2-iso-artifact-index.pdf (artifact index & notes)
- evidence-delivery-manifest.csv (mapped files + checksums)
- everblue-signed-nda.pdf (executed copy you sent)

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cEBEvidence
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/everblue (ticket EB-4592)
DocuSign (signature request): https://www.docusign.com/EB-4592-signature

Escalation / caveats: 
- We cannot include a third-party HSM vendor attestation for customer-managed keys unless EverBlue provides a vendor contact or grants Redwood permission to request it on your behalf. In lieu of a vendor attestation, we included: 
  * key rotation logs (sample export)
  * KMS configuration screenshots and design diagrams
  * operational runbook excerpt describing key management procedures

Next steps we suggest: 
1) Confirm scope (prod only vs. include preprod) by Dec 5 so we can package additional artifacts.
2) If you require HSM vendor attestation, share procurement contact or let us coordinate with your KMS vendor.
3) Schedule a 45-minute walkthrough (we're available Wed/Thu mornings PST) to walk through the Drive contents and answer auditor questions.
